title.en: Pi: Why One Claude Code User Switched

excerpt.zh: Pi为何成为一位长期Claude Code用户的新选择？作者将迁移归因于编辑器多会话限制、扩展体验和频繁更新带来的摩擦，并肯定Pi的简约与可定制性，但尚未提供性能对比。
excerpt.en: Pi wins over a longtime Claude Code user with simpler, customizable workflows, though the account offers no comparative benchmarks.

text.zh: 从Claude Code转向Pi的工作流摩擦
text.en: The Workflow Friction Behind the Move to Pi

text.zh: Pi成为一位长期Claude Code用户新的主要编程代理工具，原因是日常使用中不断累积的摩擦。在这篇个人迁移记录中，作者仍肯定Claude Code对软件开发的推动作用，但认为其产品演进越来越偏离自己的需求。
text.en: Pi has become one longtime Claude Code user’s main coding harness after a buildup of everyday frustrations. In this personal migration account, the author still credits Claude Code with helping advance software development, but argues that its product direction increasingly diverges from their needs.

text.zh: 作者列举的问题集中在工作流：其使用的VSCode连接方式同一时间只能让一个会话接收选中文本；官方图形扩展虽支持多标签页，却被指存在部分斜杠命令不可用、缺少自定义状态栏，以及多个子代理输出混杂等问题。AGENTS.md与CLAUDE.md之间的复制或链接负担，也成为不满的一部分。
text.en: The complaints center on workflow. In the author’s VSCode setup, only one connected session could receive selected text at a time. The official graphical extension supported multiple tabs, but the author reported unavailable slash commands, no custom status line, and interleaved subagent output. Copying or linking instructions between AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md added another source of friction.

text.zh: Pi的吸引力与尚待验证的问题
text.en: Pi’s Appeal and the Evidence Still Missing

text.zh: 作者还认为，频繁修改系统提示词和工具说明，会增加既有配置下行为变化的风险。相比之下，Pi在最初几天调试后，带来了作者更满意的稳定性、简约体验和可定制空间；作者已编写扩展满足自身需求。这提示，编程代理工具的价值不仅在于功能数量，也在于能否持续适配用户的审查与并行工作习惯。
text.en: The author also argues that frequent changes to system prompts and tool descriptions risk changing behavior in established setups. After several days of adjustment, Pi reportedly offered a more satisfying mix of stability, simplicity, and customization, including extensions the author wrote. The broader implication is that a coding harness’s value depends partly on how consistently it fits a user’s review and parallel-task habits.

text.zh: 不过，这仍是一份个人体验记录。所给材料没有提供受控的任务对比、可靠性测试或成本测量，也不能证明Pi普遍更快、更便宜或代码质量更高。文中提到的后续AGENTS.md支持公告，也意味着部分不满可能随版本变化；Pi能否适合其他团队，仍需结合具体工作流验证。
text.en: This remains an individual account. The supplied material includes no controlled task comparisons, reliability tests, or measured costs, so it does not establish that Pi is generally faster, cheaper, or better at producing code. The reported subsequent announcement of AGENTS.md support also suggests some complaints may change with releases. Pi’s suitability for other teams remains a workflow-specific question.
